releases.title: Release 2.0.1
releases.description: Maintenance and dependency update release with brand system modernization and quote parser enhancements.

changes.text: Upgrade to @kartikarora/brand 1.8.0 design system across all web components and docs
Prevent regression for code comments containing quotes and contractions
Bump Gradle dependencies and library versions to latest stable

releases.title: Release 2.0.0 - Major Overhaul & Web Components
releases.description: Major release introducing native Klaat Web Components (<klaat-codelab>, <klaat-step>), interactive button elements, duration calculation using kotlin.time, and comprehensive Format Guide codelabs.

changes.text: Native Klaat web components (<klaat-codelab>, <klaat-step>, action buttons) with CDN delivery
Action Buttons syntax (.buttonPrimary, .buttonSecondary, .button) with custom icon support
Interactive codelab showcase and format guide preview directly inside browser
Modernize duration parsing with kotlin.time.Duration API and remaining time calculation
Fix survey inline code formatting and button step fence rendering

releases.title: Release 1.0.0 - Initial Production Release
releases.description: Initial general availability release of Klaat - a modern Kotlin-based spiritual successor to claat for compiling Google Docs and Markdown tutorials to interactive codelabs.

changes.text: Complete Google Docs and Markdown tutorial parsing pipeline
Export to HTML, Markdown, and self-contained Offline bundles
Embedded local Ktor preview server with live reloading and auto-launching browser
GraalVM native image binaries for macOS (Apple Silicon) and Linux (x64, ARM64)
AI agent skill suite (klaat-cli, klaat-markdown-author, klaat-gdocs-author, klaat-native-manager)
